turns.text: The bond between a mother and her baby is indeed a powerful one, often referred to as attachment. I've studied the work of John Bowlby and Mary Ainsworth, who highlighted the importance of early attachment experiences in shaping our relationships later in life. As for a personal story, I don't have a childhood memory that triggers strong emotions, but I do recall a student in my child development class sharing a touching moment when their infant child reached out and held their finger for the first time – a beautiful display of attachment.
